description: In every expansion satisfying the definitions, the specified scoped elimination translation preserves satisfaction at every free-variable assignment and every tuple of available quantified placeholders.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.realize_translateAux.{u, v, u', v', w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type z} {M : Type w} [L.Structure M]
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) [(L.sum K).Structure M]
  [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M] (h : d.GoodExpansion M) {n : ℕ} (A : (L.sum K).BoundedFormula α n)
  (v : α → M) (xs : Fin n → M) : (d.translateAux A).Realize (Sum.elim v xs) ↔ A.Realize v xs
